title: Onboarding Tasks Automation and Skill Certification Catalog (2029)
author: Priya Nambiar
content:
Summary

This document defines the canonical automated onboarding task workflows and the Skill Certification Catalog used for role activation and manager sign-off at Redwood Inference. It describes the end-to-end automation triggers, task owners, competency gates, evidence requirements, and the timeline for 0–90 day signoffs. The goal is to reduce manual checklist work, ensure consistent competency measurement across teams, and provide an auditable trail for compliance-sensitive hires.

Key goals
- Reduce manual manager checklist time by 50% through automation by Q3 2029.
- Standardize competency evidence for role activation so 95% of new hires reach pass criteria within 90 days.
- Ensure auditability: every signoff has timestamped evidence (LMS completion, code reviews, manager notes).

Scope
- Applies to all full-time and long-term contractor hires (90+ days) across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and SRE. Excluded: hourly contractors and brief interns (handled by simplified flow).
- Covers technical and non-technical competencies required to be considered "fully activated" for the role.

Ownership and escalation
- People Systems (owner): automation pipelines, HRIS + identity provisioning integrations.
- People Ops (owner): certification rubric, templates, manager guidance.
- Hiring Manager (owner): day-to-day coaching, final competency signoffs.
- Engineering Manager Guild (review): validates role-specific rubrics for engineering disciplines.
- Escalation: if a hire misses 60-day competency gates, Hiring Manager escalates to People Ops and the Manager's Director for an individualized remediation plan.

Automated workflows (high level)
1) Offer accepted (Greenhouse) -> trigger People Systems job: create Workday profile, create Okta identity (dev-okta:group), allocate Slack, license request, and create a Jira onboarding epic.
2) HRIS -> create onboarding tasks in the Onboarding Task Service (OTS). OTS pushes tasks to Slack via the onboarding-bot and to email for managers.
3) Learning Management (Litmos) enrolls new hire in role track automatically. Completion events post back to OTS via webhook.
4) GitHub & Code Access: People Systems creates team memberships and triggers a repository access ticket to be auto-approved if manager has completed repo onboarding checklist in OTS.
5) 30/60/90 triggers: based on hire start_date, the OTS creates manager-review milestones and a calendar invite for the signoff. If evidence is missing, the system adds remediation tasks and notifies People Ops.

Design details and examples
- Event sources: Greenhouse (offer_accepted), Workday (employment_verified), Litmos (course_completed), GitHub (first-PR-merged), OTS (task_completed).
- Idempotency: every webhook includes onboarding_id to deduplicate events.
- Observability: onboarding-task SLOs are monitored on the People Ops dashboard: task completion within 7 days (SLO target 90%), manager signoff within 10 business days after milestone (SLO target 95%).

Skill Certification Catalog (structure)
Each role has a certification track composed of competency areas. Every competency area has: level (fundamental / proficient / advanced), pass criteria, required evidence types, and owner. Examples below show canonical fields and sample entries.

Catalog fields (for each competency)
- competency_name
- level
- pass_criteria
- evidence_required
- owner_team
- verification_method

Sample certification table (text)
Role | Competency | Level | Pass criteria | Evidence | Owner
Software Engineer | Core Coding & Tests | Proficient | Complete 2 paired PRs; 1 end-to-end unit+integration test | Merged PRs + CI badge | Eng Onboarding
ML Engineer | Model Understanding | Proficient | Demonstrate model inference pipeline end-to-end, document KV caching behavior | Notebook + runbook + manager review note | Research Applied ML
SRE | Incident Response | Fundamental | Participate in 1 game day; complete incident triage checklist | Game day ticket + manager signoff | Eng SRE
Customer Success | Product Knowledge | Fundamental | Complete product fundamentals course; shadow 2 customer calls | LMS completion + call notes | Customer Success Enablement

Evidence types (ordered by auditability)
1) LMS completion with timestamped certificate (preferred)
2) Merged code artifacts (PR link + CI badge)
3) Documented runbooks / notebooks with author metadata
4) Manager signed review note (in OTS)
5) Customer call notes or recordings (consent required)

Manager guidance: 0–90 gate checklist
- Day 0–7 (Activate): ensure identity + tooling access, complete security training, enroll in role track. Manager tasks: welcome 1:1, set 30/60/90 expectations.
- Day 8–30 (Foundations): complete fundamental competencies. Manager tasks: schedule paired work, assign first prioritised ticket, request initial check-in note in OTS.
- Day 31–60 (Contribution): complete proficient competencies and at least one merged PR or customer deliverable. Manager tasks: mid-point calibration, determine remediation if missing.
- Day 61–90 (Activation): satisfy outstanding evidence and complete final manager signoff in OTS. If any pass criteria are unmet, escalate per remediation protocol.

Automated manager signoff flow (detailed)
1. OTS generates a signoff summary with all evidence links and a pass/fail recommendation computed by the Certification Engine.
2. Manager receives the summary via Slack and email with a 7-day action window.
3. Manager can accept, request more evidence, or schedule a remediation plan. All actions create an immutable audit record.
4. If no manager action within window, People Ops receives an automated nudge and, at 14 days, creates a follow-up task assigned to the Hiring Manager's director.

Certification Engine (rules & scoring)
- Each competency gets a weighted score. Evidence types have confidence scores (LMS cert=1.0, merged PR=0.9, manager note=0.6).
- Role pass threshold is 0.80 by default but may be tuned per role (e.g., SRE activation threshold = 0.75 to emphasize on-call fundamentals).
- Edge cases: partial evidence is allowed if manager documents a remediation plan and sets new target dates in OTS.

Templates and snippets
- Example automation rule (pseudo JSON, used in People Systems pipeline):
{
  "trigger": "greenhouse.offer_accepted",
  "actions": ["create_workday_profile", "create_okta_identity", "enroll_litmos_role_track", "create_jira_onboarding_epic"]
}
- Manager signoff checklist (text):
  1) Identity & access verified (Okta group, GitHub teams)
  2) Security training complete (Litmos cert)
  3) Role-specific competencies satisfied (see Certification summary)
  4) First contribution approved (PR or CS deliverable)

KPIs and dashboards
- Onboarding Completion Rate (30 days): target 85%
- Time to First Merge / First Customer Interaction: target median 18 days
- Manager Signoff Compliance (90 days): target 95%
- People Systems SLA for provisioning: 95% of access granted within 3 business days
- Tracking: People Ops dashboard, Eng Ops dashboard, and People Systems incident alerts (pager duty).

Rollout plan and change management
- Phase 1 (pilot, Q2 2029): run workflow with Eng New Hires (n=25), collect manager feedback, tune evidence scoring.
- Phase 2 (scale, Q3 2029): enable SRE + ML Eng. Integrate remediation templates.
- Phase 3 (company-wide, Q4 2029): full rollout with analytics and HR audit support.

Accessibility, International hires, and timezones
- All automated emails and LMS content must be available in en-US and en-GB at launch. Additional languages scheduled per regional adoption.
- Calendar scheduling respects local business hours; signoff deadlines are business-day aware.

Security and privacy considerations
- Evidence that includes PII or customer data must be redacted before attaching to OTS records.
- Access grants follow least-privilege and are time-boxed until manager signoff. Permanent repo rights require manager + Eng Platform approval.

Appendix A — Remediation protocol (short)
1) Missed 60-day gate -> create remediation plan in OTS (owner, deliverables, due date).
2) People Ops review within 5 business days and offer coaching resources.
3) If not resolved by 120 days, follow performance improvement timeline per People Ops policy.

Appendix B — Common automation integrations
- HRIS: Workday
- ATS: Greenhouse
- Identity: Okta
- LMS: Litmos
- Ticketing: Jira
- Onboarding Task Service (internal): onboarding-bot service (api onboarding.redwood.internal)
